newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal faces potential EPA fine.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal faces potential EPA fine.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said Tuesday it has proposed American Dispoal Services Inc pay a $29,040 fine for allegedly failing to provide information about asbestos waste hauling.
American Disposal has not supplied the EPA with information on jobs involving asbestos waste transport in Illinois as required by an information request, the agency said.
An American Disposal spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.

"American Disposal has a history of not complying with EPA requests," the agency said in a statement. "In 1994 the company did not comply with an earlier EPA information request until a follow-up letter and an administrative order was issued.
Asbestos is a cancer-causing agent that can lead to lung cancer and lung disease many years after exposure.
